BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

2. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.

12. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Ignore burnt cables

13. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

16. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker
